[LLSU.13.1] Schema-level declarations that shape fact lifetime.

| Name | Explanation | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_logical` | `logical` lifecycle on schema — truth-maintained, retract-and-replace on change, one live fact per identity | use `ttl` with explicit retract rules (loses dwell correctness, breaks `emit ... logical`) |
| `schema_ttl` | `ttl` lifecycle on schema — TTL-bound, accumulates | not generally avoidable for event-like facts |
| `noop_reassert_suppression` | engine-level no-op reassertion suppression | live with dwell flicker and logical-fact flicker (breaks too many other things) |
